hints.title: Greedy Heaviest Passenger Pairing
hints.text: Pair the heaviest remaining person with the lightest remaining person whenever their combined weight fits within the boat limit.

hints.title: Opposite Ends Scanning
hints.text: Sort people by weight. Maintain index pointers at the lightest and heaviest individuals.

hints.title: Conditional Pointer Advancement
hints.text: If the sum of weights at low and high is at most the limit, advance the low pointer. Always decrement the high pointer and increment boat count.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def numRescueBoats(self, people: List[int], limit: int) -> int:
        people.sort()
        lo, hi = 0, len(people) - 1
        boats = 0
        while lo <= hi:
            if people[lo] + people[hi] <= limit:
                lo += 1
            hi -= 1
            boats += 1
        return boats
```

complexity.notes: Sorting followed by two-pointer greedy pairing pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Combinatorial subset matching takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space when sorting in place.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply greedy two-pointer matching pairing the heaviest with the lightest.
